snippet.title: Let's Play PSX: SuperLite 1500 Series - Nankuro (J)
snippet.description: It's a "Number Crossword", where each number represents one letter (or in this case, one sound). You need to make it so the crossword works such that everything is a word. But of course, I uh, don't speak japanese. And this sort of thing really doesn't work with automated translation.
